title: employment situation of severely mentally ill people in Oberhavel. Feasibility study and effectiveness evaluation of "Individual Placement and Support" (IPS).
summary: In a randomised controlled design, the effectiveness of IPS on employment status will be investigated following a baseline data collection.
conditions: Mental and behavioural disorders due to psychoactive substance use
Behavioural syndromes associated with physiological disturbances and physical factors

interventions.name:
IPS intervention group

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Presence of mental illness, consent of the test person or legal representative, general interest in work on the primary labour market, sufficient knowledge of German
Exclusion criteria:
Learning disability or intellectual disability, insufficient knowledge of German, physical or bodily limitations
